process_issues.description: Every Bash invocation failed before executing with the sandbox error `apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied` (seen on `gh pr view 235 --json ...`, `git diff --stat b98e363..HEAD`, and `git rev-parse HEAD`, each retried). So the PR diff, head SHA, intent, and steering context could not be read.

No reviewers were spawned: they share the same sandbox, so their mandated diff reads (`gh pr diff`, `git diff <merge_base>..HEAD`) would fail identically, and a review not grounded in the diff would be speculative. From Glob alone, the change appears to be commit 92ca985, which moves the src/adapters tests to test/unit/adapters/ (11 files) and the shared mock to test/helpers/temp-dir.mock.ts. This round reviewed nothing; re-run once the runner's sandbox can start.
